vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes open right away, outside the weekly schedule and the release-age wait, so a person always merges them

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

customManagers.description: gitleaks in the Secrets workflow: the release tag and its tarball's sha256, updated together

packageRules.description: Patch updates to dev tooling merge themselves once the required ci check passes (a group only when all of it is patch)
Node's types follow the Node version CI and users run (24)

Actions are pinned to the commit of a release (vX.Y.Z), so updates follow releases, not moved tags. Minor and patch releases at least 3 days old merge themselves once the required checks pass; pins, digests and majors wait for review. Accepted risk: release.yml runs these actions with the release token
The first pin of a bare major tag (@v5 to a vX.Y.Z commit) looks like a minor or patch update; it sets the trusted baseline, so it waits for review. Keep this rule after the automerge rule
